yearsText: 3+ years of product management experience in SaaS, ideally with self-serve or product-led growth exposure.
coreSkills: Cross-functional work with Marketing, Design, Engineering
extraction: Customer.io is hiring a Product Manager for its self-serve business, remote across the Americas. The role owns the customer experience from signup through activation and upgrade, carrying conversion and retention metrics directly. Day to day it is funnel analysis and A/B testing to find friction points, then working across Marketing, Design and Engineering to remove them. Stated requirement is 3+ years of SaaS product management, ideally with self-serve or product-led growth exposure, plus strong analytical chops and fluency using AI tools inside product workflows. Salary is zone-banded: $164,400-$187,200 (Zone 1), $150,700-$171,600 (Zone 2), $137,000-$156,000 (Zone 3). Greenhouse-hosted application, no login wall.
step: sourced 2026-08-19: years requirement (3+) sits below his 4, PLG/activation metric ownership maps onto the LaunchDarkly rollout and adoption work, fully remote Americas so no relocation question. Salary band is published and healthy. Gap is that his record is B2B enterprise rather than self-serve PLG.
